title: Back to the Future Part III
why: Marty arrives in Hill Valley on 2 September 1885 — the date is on the DeLorean's readout and on Doc's headstone.
alt: The Great Fire of London, 2 September 1666; the Japanese surrender aboard the Missouri, 2 September 1945

title: The King's Speech
why: The whole film is preparation for one broadcast: the declaration of war, 6pm on 3 September 1939.

title: Moneyball
why: The Oakland A's win their twentieth straight, 11–10 against Kansas City, on 4 September 2002.

title: September 5
why: The title is the date: the Munich Olympics hostage crisis of 5 September 1972, told entirely from the ABC Sports control room.

title: Hope and Glory
why: The Blitz opens over the East End on the afternoon of 7 September 1940 — the best summer of Bill's life.
alt: All Eyez on Me — Tupac shot on the Strip, 7 September 1996; Back to the Future Part III (Doc is shot on 7 September 1885)

title: Captain Corelli's Mandolin
why: Italy signs the armistice on 8 September 1943 and the garrison on Cephalonia is massacred days later.
alt: Elizabeth II dies at Balmoral, 8 September 2022

title: United 93
why: 11 September 2001, close to real time, from Newark to a field in Pennsylvania.
alt: 13 Hours (Benghazi, 11 September 2012); Braveheart (Stirling Bridge, 11 September 1297); Missing (the Chilean coup, 11 September 1973)

title: Cry Freedom
why: Steve Biko dies in police custody in Pretoria on 12 September 1977; Donald Woods spends the rest of the film proving it.

title: All Eyez on Me
why: Tupac Shakur dies of his gunshot wounds in Las Vegas on 13 September 1996.
alt: Roald Dahl born 13 September 1916 — Roald Dahl Day

title: 4 Little Girls
why: The 16th Street Baptist Church is bombed during Sunday school on 15 September 1963.
alt: Battle of Britain Day, 15 September 1940 — Battle of Britain (1969)

title: A Bridge Too Far
why: Operation Market Garden launches on Sunday 17 September 1944 — 35,000 men into Holland by parachute and glider.
alt: Antietam, 17 September 1862 — Glory; Katyn (the Soviet invasion of Poland, 17 September 1939)

title: Jimi: All Is by My Side
why: Jimi Hendrix dies in the Samarkand Hotel, Notting Hill, on the morning of 18 September 1970.

title: Battle of the Sexes
why: Billie Jean King beats Bobby Riggs in straight sets at the Houston Astrodome, 20 September 1973, in front of 90 million people.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
why: Bilbo's eleventy-first birthday party — 22 September — and the ring goes in the envelope.

title: Zodiac
why: Lake Berryessa, 27 September 1969 — the hooded man, the crosshairs symbol, the phone call from a payphone.
alt: Dirty Harry (1971), the Zodiac in fiction

title: Baltic Storm
why: The MS Estonia goes down in the Baltic in the early hours of 28 September 1994 with 852 dead.

title: Munich: The Edge of War
why: The Munich Agreement is signed in the small hours of 29/30 September 1938; Chamberlain waves the paper the next day.

title: September 30, 1955
why: The title is the date — the day James Dean died, and what it does to a small-town Arkansas campus that night.
alt: Life (2015); Munich: The Edge of War — 'peace for our time', 30 September 1938
